style: Bright and encouraging, like a coach on the design team. One line per event, nothing more.
lines: Here's an order. Drag the handle on the package's edge, or the slider. The volume stays locked, so watch the material.
Tap a real can to put it on the graph next to the best can of its size.
Pick an order, then tap Pack the case. Compare how much space cans and boxes leave empty.
The model curve shows material for every width. Tap Reveal best to check its lowest point.
This trial is within half a percent of the minimum material for this order.
This trial is within half a percent of the minimum cost for this lid price.
Pricier lids push the best can taller and thinner.
Cheaper lids push the best can shorter and wider.
Compare your trials with the best point. Drag the handle again, or pick another Order.
Pick another Order and tap Pack the case to compare the space left empty.
Tap another real can to compare it with the best can of its own size.
